name: 折射玻璃透镜
title: 折射玻璃透镜
description: 悬浮在页面上的光线步进 3D 玻璃体：折射背后的标题、图片或视频，边缘色散出彩条，朝向面带影棚反射，下方投出带焦散光斑的软影；七种形状点击涟漪形变，跟随指针、可拖拽甩动带边缘反弹、挤压拉伸随速度变形，内部可磨砂；空闲缓慢漂移、稳定后降频自睡，尊重系统减动效。
cardDescription: 光线步进玻璃体折射标题与媒体，点击在七种形状间熔变。
keywords: 光线步进玻璃体折射标题与媒体
点击在七种形状间熔变

prompt:
Implement the "FluidGlass" component from zero: a raymarched 3D glass object floating over the page that refracts whatever is behind it — a headline drawn to a texture, an image or looping video, or a solid colour — and follows the cursor. It supports seven shapes (lens, blob, cube, pill, torus, prism, diamond), morphs between them with a ripple and a squash-stretch wobble, disperses light into colour fringes, casts a soft shadow with a caustic glow, frosts its interior, and can be dragged and flung around its container. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages or font files; media comes only through the src prop (data URIs and same-origin assets are fine). ## Structure & rendering - Pure React + CSS + WebGL2: FluidGlass.jsx and FluidGlass.css. React >= 18; no runtime dependencies. - Root is a `
` filling its container (width/height 100%), carrying `data-interaction` (follow/static/drag) and `data-clickable`. Inside: a full-bleed ``; an invisible `__handle` div (a 2×radius-sized circle following the object each frame) that carries the pointer events in drag/clickable modes (grab/grabbing cursors, touch-action none in drag); a visually-hidden `

` repeating the text for screen readers; and a `__content` layer where children render with pointer events re-enabled (the layer itself is click-through). - Renderer: webgl2, alpha true, premultiplied true, high-performance preference. One fullscreen triangle. Programs are compiled per shape-pair key (`"from>to"` plus a supersampled variant when devicePixelRatio ≥ 1.75) and cached; compilation uses the parallel-compile extension when present and the loop waits for readiness. A plain content program renders the background (media + text + colour) when the glass programs are still warming up. - Content sources: the `text` prop is drawn to an offscreen canvas (font from container styles unless fontFamily/textColor/fontWeight/fontSize are given; auto-fitted to 84% of width and 64% of height across `\n`-split lines, −3% letter-spacing) and uploaded as a mipmapped texture; `src` loads an image (or a muted looping autoplaying video when the URL ends in a video extension) cover- or contain-mapped per `fit`; `background` (colour string or transparent) underlays both. Text redraws on resize, font load and theme attribute changes. - The glass shader raymarches a bounded SDF field (96 steps) with the shape pair mixed by the morph factor, plus a tri-sine ripple term during morphs/clicks. Entry refracts by 1/ior; the interior marches to the exit face (up to 3 total internal reflections); exit refraction lands on the content plane, which is resampled with per-pixel footprints (texture gradients) — red and blue re-refracted at ±dispersion offsets for chromatic fringing. Fresnel mixes a studio-light reflection (two soft key/strip lights, or the real backdrop for the mirrored ray when it hits the content plane); tint colours the glass by path length (strength from `tint`); `frost` rings an 8-tap blur through the interior; a facing rim light lifts edges. - Shadow: a second pass renders the object's soft shadow + caustic into a 160px framebuffer sampled from a light direction (−0.42, 0.55 up); the main pass darkens and adds the caustic glow to the content under the object, scaled by `shadow` and the intro presence. ## Motion & interaction - Body physics: the object's centre springs toward its goal — the pointer (interaction "follow"), a fixed relative `position` anchor, or the drag offset — at ω = 24 × 0.18^smoothness (34 while grabbed), integrated at 240 Hz sub-steps. Idle drift adds a slow two-frequency Lissajous wobble around the anchor when `idle` is on (random phase per instance). - Drag & fling: with interaction "drag", pressing within 1.1 × radius grabs the object (grabbing cursor); releasing above 60 px/s velocity flings it — friction decay with edge bounces (restitution 0.62) that kick the wobble spring — until it slows, then it settles back toward its anchor clamped inside the container. A press that moves less than 6px and lands near the object is a click. - Click: kicks the squash spring (`wobble`-scaled) and, with `morphOnClick` and a multi-shape `cycle` (the `shapes` prop, defaulting to all seven), advances to the next shape; the morph eases over 0.85s (0.35s reduced) mixing the two SDFs with a ripple pulse, and `onShapeChange` fires. `shape` prop changes retarget the same morph. - Wobble: velocity drives a squash-stretch — a stretch spring (target 1 + clamp(speed/1800) × wobble) squashes the object along its motion direction; tilt springs lean it ±0.7 rad with velocity; the spin prop (rad/s) continuously tumbles it, with per-shape tumble/sway mixes and base orientations so each shape settles naturally. - Intro: fades/pops in over 0.5s (scale spring from 0) when `intro` is on. - Reduced motion: no drift, no time-based ripple/blur animation, no tilt or stretch, no spin; morphs shorten; everything else (refraction, drag) still works. - Frame loop self-sleep: when fully settled (not grabbed/flying, no morph, low velocities, |spin| ≤ 1) it paces to ~12 fps and keeps only the idle sources alive; it stops when nothing is busy and wakes on any pointer, resize, media or settings event. Visibility and document visibility gate the loop; context loss freezes and restore rebuilds. Unmount releases the video, cancels the frame, removes all listeners/observers and deletes GL objects. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | text | string | "Look closer." | The headline refracted by the glass (also the screen-reader label). | | textColor | string | - | Text colour; falls back to the container's computed colour. | | fontFamily | string | - | Text font family; falls back to the container's. | | fontWeight | number | 600 | Text weight. | | fontSize | number | - | Font size in px; auto-fitted when omitted. | | src | string | - | Image or video URL refracted by the glass. | | fit | "cover" \| "contain" | "cover" | Media fit inside the container. | | background | string | "transparent" | Backdrop colour behind the text/media. | | shape | string | "torus" | Starting shape: lens, blob, cube, pill, torus, prism or diamond. | | shapes | string[] | - | Click-morph cycle; defaults to all seven shapes. | | size | number | 260 | Object diameter in px, floored at 16; also capped by the container. | | refraction | number | 1 | Refraction strength 0–2 (ior 1.0–2.0). | | dispersion | number | 0.35 | Chromatic fringe strength 0–1. | | reflection | number | 1 | Studio reflection strength, 0–2. | | frost | number | 0 | Interior frosting 0–1. | | color | string | "#ffffff" | Glass tint colour (hex / rgb). | | tint | number | 0 | Tint strength 0–1 (colours the glass by path length). | | shadow | number | 0.5 | Cast shadow + caustic strength 0–1. | | elevation | number | 0.4 | Object height above the content plane, 0–3. | | interaction | "follow" \| "static" \| "drag" | "follow" | Follows the pointer, stays put, or is draggable. | | smoothness | number | 0.5 | Spring softness 0–1; 0 is stiff, 1 is lazy. | | wobble | number | 0.5 | Squash-stretch and morph ripple energy 0–1. | | spin | number | 0.3 | Continuous spin speed (rad/s). | | idle | boolean | true | Slow ambient drift when untouched. | | morphOnClick | boolean | true | Click morphs to the next shape in the cycle. | | onShapeChange | (shape: string) => void | - | Called when a morph lands. | | position | [number, number] | [0.5, 0.5] | Relative anchor in the container (static/drag modes). | | intro | boolean | true | Scale-and-fade entrance. | | maxDevicePixelRatio | number | 2 | DPR cap, 0.5–3 (also budgeted to ~5MP). | | className | string | "" | Extra class names for the root. | | style | CSSProperties | - | Inline styles for the root. | | children | ReactNode | - | DOM content layered above the canvas (click-through layer). | ## Delivery & validation - Deliver the complete content of FluidGlass.jsx and FluidGlass.css plus install steps and the usage example; no ellipses, no "fill in the core yourself" placeholders. - Validate: the glass bends the headline/media behind it with believable refraction, colour fringes at the rim, a facing reflection and a soft shadow with a caustic; all seven shapes render and click-morphs ripple between them with onShapeChange firing; follow mode tracks the pointer, drag mode grabs/flings/bounces and settles; frost blurs the interior; tint colours the glass; size, position and elevation behave; text auto-fits and redraws on resize/fonts; video media loops and pauses off-screen; reduced motion removes drift/spin/stretch but keeps refraction and drag; off-screen and hidden tabs pause; context loss/restore recovers; unmount frees everything; 375 / 768 / 1440 wide without overflow.
